senses.gloss: (= b. h. פָּצַח) to burst, open, v. פְּצִיחַ.
(cmp. פָּצַע Hif.; v. Syr. פצח P. Sm. 3208) [to spread,] to sparkle, be bright, v. פַּצִּיחַ.

units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:12">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>פַּצּוּחֵי עינא</he> to apply a paint (on the Sabbath) for the sake of brightening the eye-sight.
